split: discovery = odd autosomes; confirmation = even autosomes; confirmation touches only the frozen survivor list
covariate_note: every pair is adjusted (rank-partial) for GC, gene density, baseline cardiomyocyte compartment and baseline lamina, except a covariate that is the pair's own X or Y; the screen asks what predicts change beyond baseline genome architecture
same_source_note: pairs inside one study (Shen 2026 lamina and RNA; one Hi-C series) are excluded: the screen targets cross-study relationships no single paper could report
excluded_note: already tested by registered campaigns (PRs #5, #6); matched as unordered pairs

confirmation.rule: same sign as discovery, sign*rho >= 0.05, one-sided circular-shift p <= 0.05 / (number of survivors)

prior_exposure_disclosure: all inputs were opened by earlier campaigns; the correlations of every non-excluded pair have never been computed by this program; the confirmation half is untouched only at the level of these pairings
claim_ceiling: a confirmed pair is a pre-registered cross-study association between public datasets; prior-art review decides whether it is known or new; no mechanism
feature_extra_covariates_note: pre-discovery review blocker: a KO-minus-WT compartment delta is adjusted for its own WT baseline PC1 whenever it is in a pair, so a global compartment-strength change cannot pass as a predictor association
method_notes: discovery selection uses min(p_neg, p_pos) without doubling: effectively two-sided at 0.02
tiles with any missing value in X, Y or a covariate are dropped before shifting, so each chromosome's retained tiles are shifted as a contiguous ring
circular shifts are at least 10 tiles from identity where the chromosome half has more than 20 retained tiles
expression log2 fold changes use +1 CPM pseudocounts and carry no baseline-expression covariate; a partial expression-level confound remains and is disclosed

GSE126459 HOMER PC1 build taken as hg38: our hg38 pipeline on the same samples reproduced the deposited PC1 at genome-wide Spearman 0.92 and 0.88 (replication campaign method validation), which a build mismatch would not allow
